summary: Preinstall script fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated sibling payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`, which runs automatically on `npm install`. setup.mjs is obfuscated (hex-named identifiers, string-lookup decoders) and, when `bun` is not on PATH, downloads the Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temp directory, marks it executable, and then invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~711KB Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) with heavy obfuscation — a single-line body, hex identifiers, a large mixed-type constant table, an array-rotator decoder (`WV8StW`), and a base-N string decoder (`hc1jfK9`). The file has no exports and is not referenced by anything in dist/; its only invocation site is the preinstall dropper. The stated SDK purpose does not require a second language runtime or an opaque math_init bundle, and the payload cannot be inspected without executing it under the fetched runtime. The alternate-runtime dropper pattern (pulling in Bun solely to execute an obfuscated sibling) evades Node-only scanners and hides the true install-time behavior from the installer.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
